headline: F5 Patches BIG-IP APM Zero-Day Under Active Attack
summary: F5 released security updates for a critical BIG-IP APM zero-day vulnerability that is being actively exploited in remote code execution attacks, according to Bleeping Computer and The Register. The Register adds that both CISA and F5 warned of the active exploitation.
